# Roslyn Source Generator Patterns Reference

## Incremental Discovery Pattern

```csharp
[Generator]
public sealed class ContractProjectionGenerator : IIncrementalGenerator
{
    public void Initialize(IncrementalGeneratorInitializationContext context)
    {
        var candidates = context.SyntaxProvider.CreateSyntaxProvider(
            predicate: static (node, _) => node is InterfaceDeclarationSyntax { AttributeLists.Count: > 0 },
            transform: static (ctx, ct) => TryCreateTarget(ctx, ct))
            .Where(static target => target != null);

        context.RegisterSourceOutput(candidates, static (spc, target) =>
        {
            if (target is null)
            {
                return;
            }

            spc.AddSource(target.HintName, Render(target));
        });
    }
}
```

## Projection Matrix

| Input fact | Keep | Drop |
|---|---|---|
| Namespace | Yes |  |
| Type name | Yes |  |
| Trigger metadata | Yes |  |
| Full syntax tree |  | Drop after projection |
| Unused symbols |  | Drop |

## Deterministic Emission Pattern

| Concern | Agent move |
|---|---|
| Hint names | Use a stable convention such as `TypeName.g.cs`. |
| Ordering | Sort members before rendering. |
| Headers | Emit a stable auto-generated header. |
| Namespaces | Match consumer namespace rules exactly. |

```csharp
private static string Render(GeneratorTarget target)
{
    var builder = new StringBuilder();
    builder.AppendLine("// <auto-generated />");
    builder.AppendLine("namespace " + target.Namespace + ";");
    builder.AppendLine();
    builder.AppendLine("internal static partial class " + target.Name + "Generated");
    builder.AppendLine("{");
    foreach (var member in target.MemberNames.OrderBy(static x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal))
    {
        builder.AppendLine("    // emitted member: " + member);
    }
    builder.AppendLine("}");
    return builder.ToString();
}
```

## Diagnostic Pattern

```csharp
internal static readonly DiagnosticDescriptor InvalidTargetRule = new(
    id: "IFXG1001",
    title: "Generator target is invalid",
    messageFormat: "Type '{0}' does not satisfy the generation contract",
    category: "Usage",
    defaultSeverity: DiagnosticSeverity.Error,
    isEnabledByDefault: true);
```

## Generator Test Pattern

```csharp
[TestMethod]
public void Emits_source_for_valid_target()
{
    var compilation = CreateCompilation("[GenerateClient] public partial interface IClient { } ");
    GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new ContractProjectionGenerator());
    driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out var outputCompilation, out var diagnostics);

    Assert.AreEqual(0, diagnostics.Length);
    Assert.IsTrue(outputCompilation.SyntaxTrees.Any(tree => tree.FilePath.EndsWith(".g.cs", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
}
```
